column_description: TEXT. PK & FK → plant_record.SnapKey. Links to mechanical condition snapshot.

JSONB column. Captures tracker status, glass / back-sheet health, electrical connections and cleaning history for a panel string or block at a given snapshot, allowing O&M teams to query a single JSONB field for mechanical diagnostics.
